text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We did it...! We beat a powerhouse 
team...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We're really getting stronger, aren't we? 
Ehehe...♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can win the next one too, keeping 
this momentum up...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No... I'm going to win, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone on the team is super hyped 
up too, all like, "We're gonna win this!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Next up is finally... our showdown with 
Team First... right!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Strangely enough, Rice isn't scared at 
all. If anything, Rice is excited—Rice's 
legs are tingling to run...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's give the final showdown 
everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
………… To think we could actually beat a 
team like that.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Haste makes waste, Little Cocon! We've 
made up our minds too.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
If I continue to train every day without 
wavering, I'm sure I can become even 
stronger...!
